sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS TotalNonCharteredSchools
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18
AND s.County = 'Los Angeles'
AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
